findings.observation: Verbatim: const first = firstParams as GridSortCellParams; and const second = secondParams as GridSortCellParams; Node_modules @mui/x-data-grid models gridSortModel.d.ts:18 types GridComparatorFn params as GridSortCellParams<V>, so the casts add nothing. first.api.getRow(first.id).name reads an untyped GridValidRowModel field, so a rename of name to undefined makes gridStringOrNumberComparator return 0 and the sort silently stops ordering by name, with no compile error.
findings.remediation: Owner implementation, non-blocking: drop the two casts if the column type already infers the params, and read the name through the NamedWorkItemRow type (for example a typed getRow result) instead of the untyped field.
